The viewer merely observes this ongoing, cyclical formation of linguistic patterns.

Like deep-sea creatures emerging from darkness, the glowing letters float in gentle, randomized motion before spontaneously organizing into words. Viewers witness an ongoing, cyclical dance where meaning arises organically from chaos, only to dissolve back into the stream of floating characters.
